Name: Gold Plated Food
Author: PhoenixInanis
Description:
This mod adds 54 new foods, 1 new item, and 1 big craftable. The big craftable is the gold plater, unlocked at level 4 Farming, and requiring 5 iron bars and 25 coal to make. The new item is gold dust, you get 5 of these by milling gold ore. To make a gold plated food, take one of the foods from the list below, one gold dust, and put them into the gold plater. Wait 5 in-game hours, and receive a gold plated food.

The list of foods that can be plated with gold are as follows:
Wild Horseradish, Leek, Parsnip, Banana, Green Bean, Cauliflower, Potato, Garlic, Kale, Rhubarb, Melon, Tomato, Blueberry, Hot Pepper, Radish, Red Cabbage, Starfruit, Corn, Eggplant, Artichoke, Pumpkin, Bok Choy, Yam, Cranberries, Beet, Salmonberry, Hops, Spice Berry, Grape, Spring Onion, Strawberry, Wild Plum, Hazelnut, Blackberry, Winter Root, Crystal Fruit, Snow Yam, Sweet Gem Berry, Coffee Bean, Ancient Fruit, Apple, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Pomegranate, Cherry, Ginger, Taro Root, Pineapple, Mango, Carrot, Squash, Broccoli, & Powdermelon.
